RiskStatement: A single identity can both originate a patient charge and submit it to a payer, with no independent review between creation and billing. This is the primary control failure in healthcare billing fraud.
Remediation: Revoke the non-primary entitlement. If cross-coverage is operationally required, provision time-bound access via access package with mandatory expiration.

RiskStatement: A single identity can create a charge and post the payment or write-off against it, enabling lapping and cash misappropriation with no reconciliation break.
Remediation: Enforce separation between charge origination and cash application. Backfill coverage must use temporary elevation, not standing grants.

RiskStatement: Infrastructure administrators holding standing unrestricted PHI access violate HIPAA minimum necessary. Administrative duties do not require clinical record content.
Remediation: Replace standing PHI access with break-glass elevation via PIM, time-bound and alerting on activation.

RiskStatement: A clinician who documents an encounter and also assigns its billing codes can inflate reimbursement without a second party detecting the discrepancy. Known as upcoding.
Remediation: Remove coding entitlement from clinical staff. Route documentation improvement work through a coding liaison who holds no prescribing rights.
